services.name: Checkup

services.story: The main story: a $179 checkup and cleaning at Maple Grove care home. Nothing is taken. The office bills Alex's plan its own way.

services.name: Checkup and cleaning
services.story: The same visit, paid privately: a card is saved for the $89 visit fee, and Rosie texts the bill when Daniel texts DONE.

services.name: Tooth pain visit
services.story: Tooth pain at the care home. Only the $89 visit fee is promised. Daniel prices any treatment at the visit, with Alex's yes first.

services.name: Denture reline
services.story: A $150 denture reline at Maple Grove, paid privately in full when booking.

services.name: New denture
services.story: A new denture, priced by Daniel from photos at $640. A $160 deposit when booking, and Rosie texts the bill for the rest.

services_shape: visit types in a chair, each with a set length; a new patient's first visit has two parts (the hygienist's X-rays and cleaning, then the dentist's exam); treatment found at the exam is booked later as its own visit; every visit needs a free chair
questions_before_times: for you, your child, or someone you help (a care home resident)
which visit: the office's own visit types only, never a symptom typed into the AI
a dental plan (its name only) or paying yourself
safety_stop: face or jaw swelling with a fever, or trouble breathing or swallowing
a knocked-out adult tooth, or bleeding that won't stop
swallowed something poisonous, or too much of a medicine
first_steps: Health history, consent and the dental plan's papers
A written price estimate for self-pay patients
The care home's or school's OK
license: always: each dentist and each dental hygienist holds their own active license from the state's dental board
staff_skills: dentists: exams, treatment, dentures; hygienists: X-rays, cleanings, fluoride and sealants; only people cleared for mobile visits go to care homes and schools
messages_never: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the plan, the reason, the results or the dentist's name (when the dentist comes to a care home, school or home, the dentist's name stays, for the door check); X-rays and results never go through Rosie
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
